description: For every index \(v\) satisfying \(\varphi_v(\langle w,z\rangle)\simeq\varphi_{\operatorname{left}(w)}(\operatorname{right}(w))\) for all \(w,z\), the same map \(c_v(w)=s(v,w)\) satisfies \(w\in K_0\Longleftrightarrow c_v(w)\in K_z\) for every \(w\), where \(K_z\) is halting on input zero.
